pca_truncation.drop_reason: Midrib-content modes (sqrt(droop^2 + along^2) > 0.3 in eigenvector) had their eigenvalues multiplied by 0.25 (sigma x 0.50) to dampen midrib variance. Eliminates the upright-leaf failure mode (Gaussian draws on droop or along axes producing leaves with reduced lateral spread; observed in canopy5_day180_pca_clamp_scale0.3 seeds 42, 45) while preserving small biological midrib variation. See PLAN_PARAMETRIC_LEAF_SHAPE_2026-05-09_REV1.md section 'Post-alpha: midrib eigenvalue damping'. | Intercepts shifted by +c·σ_k·sign(hw_sum)·U_k for modes [3, 5, 7] (c=1.0, threshold=0.5); bakes a mean-widening offset into per-rank intercepts so the narrow tail of mode-k draws lands at the old mean (or above), eliminating sub-baseline narrow plants while preserving full PCA variance. Width distribution now skews wider on average.
